title: Emoji Support
content: Add emoji functionality to the application. Emoji picker: grid of emoji organized by category (Smileys, People, Animals, Food, Activities, Travel, Objects, Symbols). Search/filter functionality at top. Recent/frequently used section. Picker trigger: button with Smile icon. Picker position: absolute dropdown or modal. Use native emoji characters for cross-platform compatibility. Render emojis at appropriate size (text-xl in text, larger standalone). Support emoji in: comments, messages, reactions, usernames. Add emoji reactions component: row of common emoji with count and add button. Store emoji as Unicode characters. Consider emoji skin tone selector for people emoji. Keyboard shortcut: trigger picker with ":" autocomplete. Handle emoji in text input gracefully.

variants.simple: Add emoji picker and support throughout the app.

variants.advanced: Add comprehensive emoji functionality to the application. Emoji picker component: grid layout (8-10 columns), categories with tabs or horizontal scroll (Smileys, People, Animals, Food, Activities, Travel, Objects, Symbols, Flags), search input with filter, recent/frequently used section at top (stored in localStorage). Picker trigger: button with Smile icon, toggles picker visibility. Picker positioning: absolute below/above trigger based on viewport space, or modal on mobile. Emoji rendering: use native Unicode characters for cross-platform compatibility, twemoji library for consistent appearance if needed. Emoji data: use emoji-mart, emojibase, or similar for comprehensive emoji list with keywords for search. Size handling: text-xl or text-2xl for inline emoji, larger (text-4xl+) for standalone/reactions. Text input integration: insert emoji at cursor position, handle selection replacement. ":" autocomplete: detect :keyword pattern in input, show filtered suggestions dropdown, replace on selection. Skin tone modifier: for people emoji, show skin tone selector (5 Fitzpatrick scale tones), remember user preference. Emoji reactions component: horizontal row of common emoji (👍❤️😂😮😢😡), click to add/toggle, show count per emoji, add button to open full picker. Storage: store as Unicode characters in database, renders correctly everywhere. Accessibility: emoji picker needs keyboard navigation, emoji characters announced by screen readers, consider aria-label for icon-only emoji buttons. Performance: lazy load emoji data, virtualize large lists. Recent tracking: store last 20-30 used emoji in localStorage, show at top of picker.
